# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Guide Price €1,995,000 – Subject to Contract An exceptional detached residence extending to approximately 6,000 sq ft on c.1.25 acres. The property is formally arranged as a 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom residence, with additional versatile rooms that have previously been used to provide extra guest sleeping accommodation.
